_firstInstallRouterOrdering._note: Phase 267.2-06 (HOOK-08). scripts/first-install-router.cjs is registered in the UserPromptSubmit chain immediately AFTER scripts/mva-detect.cjs and before scripts/brain-derivation-drain.cjs. This is metadata for a human reader (and any future drift test) -- it is NOT consumed by Claude Code's hook loader, which only reads the 'hooks' key in hooks/hooks.json.
